# Kitchen Substitute

> Ingredient substitutions with exact amounts — offline, no ads. Free web guide: US and metric amounts, pantry ranking, function notes, trade-offs, baking-safety flags. 361 of 363 substitutes include a full ratio breakdown (the exceptions give safety guidance instead of numbers). 155 ingredients. iPhone app: $0.99 once, offline, no ads, no account.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6815952974

## Ingredient pages
- [Full index](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/) with search over all 155 ingredients
- One page per ingredient: `https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/substitute/{ingredient-id}/` (all ids listed in sitemap.xml). Examples:
- [Substitute for Buttermilk](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/substitute/buttermilk/)
- [Substitute for Eggs](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/substitute/eggs/)
- [Substitute for Baking soda](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/substitute/baking-soda/)
- [Substitute for Baking powder](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/substitute/baking-powder/)
- [Substitute for Heavy cream](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/substitute/heavy-cream/)
- [Substitute for Cornstarch](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/substitute/cornstarch/)
- [Substitute for All-purpose flour](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/substitute/all-purpose-flour/)
- [Substitute for Butter](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/substitute/butter/)
- [Substitute for Cream cheese](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/substitute/cream-cheese/)

Cross-reference swap pages ("substitute A for B"): `https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/swap/{a}-for-{b}/`.

Ratios are researched dataset values, not guarantees; the generator copies every amount verbatim from the dataset and never invents copy. Contact: aechopp@gmail.com
